correctness.rationale: For a|F(b), b|F(a) with F(t)=t²−t+1, gcd(a,b)=1 and M=(F(a)+F(b)−1)/(ab) is a positive integer. For a<b, r=F(a)/b is integer 1≤r<a, and the Vieta conjugate root satisfies F(r)+F(a)−1=Mar, preserving reciprocal divisibility and M while strictly decreasing the maximum. Every sequence reaches (1,1), but any nontrivial pair gives M>1, contradiction. Squarefree integrality implies every prime has an F-incoming edge; the cyclotomic order-six condition forces p≡1 mod6 (excluding 2,3), while loop/two-cycle exclusion forces at least three vertices. Independent direct divisor search checked 2671 candidates with a<500. Finite tests are not the all-integer descent proof.
